title: Mosquito Tone (15 kHz)
blurb: A pure 15 kHz tone — the infamous mosquito sound most teenagers can hear and most adults cannot. High-frequency hearing declines steadily with age, so this single tone functions as a rough hearing test, a science demo, and a legendary classroom prank all at once. It was even deployed commercially as a teen deterrent outside shops, which is a genuinely strange thing to have existed. Play it in mixed company and map exactly who still has their top end, based entirely on who winces first.
origin: Pure 15 kHz sine tone — audibility drops sharply with age, hence the name.
